exp1.description: Development, maintenance, and refactoring of internal applications. Updating code and features to new technologies, including migrations to PHP 8.1 and modernization of the front-end with React.js. Responsible for the full front-end and back-end cycle, ensuring continuity and evolutionary support, without direct database administration.

exp2.description: Development and maintenance of the front-end and back-end of the website in Grails and the mobile app in AngularJS. Comprehensive management of the PostgreSQL database, using Groovy, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS to ensure the proper functioning and evolution of the applications.

exp3.description: Background in IT technical support and user assistance, working in collaborative and agile environments (Scrum). Experience in effective communication, customer service, networking, and teamwork, combined with digital content management, video editing, and online product administration, using tools such as Microsoft Office and Google Workspace.
